name: standard
description: Balanced default: plan, implement, deterministic verification, independent review, risk-based approval.

stages.title: Create a bounded implementation plan
stages.instruction: Inspect the codebase and produce a concise implementation plan in your response. Do not modify code unless needed to capture a project-local plan.

stages.title: Implement bounded change
stages.instruction: Implement only the requested bounded change. Inspect the repository first; preserve unrelated changes.
